name: Video
description: A video file played in the page with the native <video> element, with controls and captions. For a video hosted on another service, use Embed.

elements.name: Video
elements.description: The video file, with one or more <source> formats

elements.name: Controls
elements.description: Play and pause, seek, volume, captions and full screen

elements.name: Captions
elements.description: <track kind="captions"> for speech and meaningful sound

elements.name: Poster
elements.description: Still image shown before playback starts

elements.name: Caption
elements.description: Visible text below the player, such as a title or transcript link

configOptions.options: Click to play, Autoplay muted (with a pause control)

variants.caption: Full bleed — edge to edge between text
With caption — text and transcript link below

usageNotes: Provide captions for prerecorded speech (WCAG 1.2.2) with <track kind="captions">. When the picture carries information the audio doesn't, add audio description or a transcript (WCAG 1.2.3, 1.2.5).

Don't autoplay with sound. Sound that plays for more than three seconds needs a way to stop it (WCAG 1.4.2), and moving video that starts on its own and lasts more than five seconds needs a way to pause it (WCAG 2.2.2).
Keep the controls attribute unless you build custom controls. Custom buttons need accessible names and must work with the keyboard.
Set width and height or a CSS aspect-ratio so the page doesn't shift while the video loads, and use preload="metadata" with a poster to keep the first load light.
Use Video for files you host. For YouTube, Vimeo and other services that provide an iframe, use Embed.
htmlOutline:
<video controls>
  <source src="intro.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <track kind="captions" src="intro.vtt" srclang="en" label="English">
</video>
